name: io.github.solrudev.simpleinstaller.impl.installer.PackageInstallerApi16$InstallLauncherActivity
description: The SimpleInstaller library by solrudev uses this Activity on its older Android installation path. It sends the APK to Android's installer and returns the installation result to the app.
disableEffect: On this installation path, SimpleInstaller cannot open Android's APK installer or return its result.
